findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: SECOND REPEAT: No disposable towel or hand drying device was observed in the two restrooms. CORRECTED: The person-in-charge (PIC) was informed and paper towels were provided. Ensure paper towels are available in the restrooms at all times for proper hand drying and to allow employees to turn off faucets without recontaminating clean hands. This is the third observation within one month of paper towels not being available in the restrooms (March 6, March 16 and March 26).
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; or (C) A heated-air hand drying device; or (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures. [PF]

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: Inspector found 5 boxes of Milo’s sweet tea on the floor in the facility. Boxes and gallon jugs both read keep refrigerated between 33F and 42F. According to the assistant manager, the tea has been unrefrigerated since the weekend when it was delivered. She stated that her manager directed them to leave the tea there for storage. The manager was not at the facility at the time of inspection. The assistant was in contact with her by phone. The facility was given two options for dealing with the tea. The items could either be discarded or embargoed.  If embargoed, the facility would be responsible for contacting Milo’s corporation to determine if the Keep Refrigerated statement was for quality or safety. The facility chose to voluntarily discard the 20 gallons of tea. The tea was poured down the sink. The boxes and jugs remain for the facility to scan for their records. The violation is considered corrected on site. Please follow cold holding directions for food safety unless there is documentation form the company showing that the keep refrigerated statement is for food quality only and not a food safety statement. 

(A) (2) Temperature Control for safety (TCS) FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less.

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control
findings.comment:
4-301.11: The inspector observed the dairy cooler in the back room to be empty. It is holding at 45F. Do not use this cooler unless it is capable of holding food at 41F or below. There is no independent thermometer in the unit and the bottom of the unit is heavily soiled. Maintain and clean this cold holding unit before putting it back into use.  A follow up will be conducted on 12/5/24. Ensure that the unit is holding cold, clean and has an independent thermometer by this date.

EQUIPMENT for cooling and heating FOOD, and holding cold and hot FOOD, shall be sufficient in number and capacity to provide FOOD temperatures.
